09. MONITORING OF AUTONOMOUS COLLEGES
9.I IQAC cell shall be established in thc college for regular monitoring of the college under intimation to UGC. The

performance of the College. The report shall also be put on public domain on the website of the College. The extemal
peer review shall be conducted atleast oncc in a year.
9.2 On receipt of adverse report by the external peer team of IQAC or in case of complaint, UGC has the Power to
constitute its own Expert Committee for careful scrutiny of the report and may revoke thc autonomous.status of the

upload the minutcs of thc mcetings on the college websitc.

report and utilization certificate annually as per the prescribed formals.

an undertaking to this effect shall be uploaded on the College website.
g:l The number of contractual faculty in an autonomous coltege should not be more than l07o of che total number of

the degree is in consonance with UGC Notification on Specification of Degrees, 2014 as amended from time to time.
